newsReports.title: Cumulative Command Telemetry: Kebbi Leads +2.3 SPS Gains Behind Osun
newsReports.summary: Kebbi leads +2.3 SPS gains while Osun holds 6.8 SPS.
newsReports.lead_narrative: Cumulative subnational telemetry across the 37 jurisdictions as of 2026-11-25 highlights Kebbi (+2.3 SPS) for net upward movement while Osun anchors the overall Security Performance Score table at 6.8 SPS.
story_body: Leading Security Performance Score positions across the 37 jurisdictions on 2026-11-25 stand at 1. Osun (6.8 SPS, 0), 2. Benue (6.6 SPS, +0.8), and 3. Kebbi (6.3 SPS, +2.3). Osun holds a 0.2-point margin over Benue in the primary ranking.

On the Jurisdiction Threat Index side, notable readings include Zamfara (5.1 JTI, 0), Borno (4.9 JTI, +0.6), and Yobe (4.6 JTI, 0), highlighting jurisdictions where secondary risk or instability indicators behave differently from top SPS totals.

Lower-ranked jurisdictions on the SPS board include Zamfara (4.0 SPS, -1.2), Yobe (4.0 SPS, 0), and Taraba (4.0 SPS, -1.2), illustrating the spread between frontrunners and trailing states as of 2026-11-25.
Regional distribution across geopolitical zones spans SW (6), NC (7), NW (7), SS (6), NE (6), SE (5), capturing broad subnational comparisons without relying on single-location snapshots.
